target.title: fix: surface terminal agent run failures
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

An embedded agent can reach a terminal failure while returning no visible payload. The reply operation records the failure, but the normal chat path previously had nothing to send, so an interactive request could appear to be ignored.

## Why This Change Was Made

The contributor patch correctly identified the missing presentation, but its early `kind: "final"` returns bypassed pending tool/block drains, reply normalization, dedupe, session bookkeeping, and usage/model metadata.

This rewrite carries a prepared terminal-failure payload through the existing success-shaped run result. The outer reply owner waits for pending delivery, evaluates the canonical side-effect and source-delivery evidence, then appends the failure only when nothing was already delivered. Existing visible errors, message-tool/source replies, block streams, cron/approval side effects, non-direct silent policy, and heartbeat-specific copy remain authoritative.

## User Impact

Interactive terminal run failures now produce one safe visible failure instead of silence. A reply already delivered through another supported path is not duplicated, and heartbeat failures retain heartbeat-specific guidance.

Release note context: Fix interactive requests appearing to be ignored when an agent run ends in a terminal failure without a visible payload.

## Evidence

- Testbox `tbx_01kwsmzw7a12qk14aezg1w0wbr` on the final rebased head:
  - 229 focused execution tests passed.
  - 67 payload normalization/threading tests passed.
  - 71 full `runReplyAgent` E2E tests passed.
  - Exact eight-file `check:changed` core/coreTests/docs gate passed, including core/test typechecks, lint, import-cycle and repository guards.
- E2E regression proof holds a pending tool-result delivery open, confirms the reply does not finish early, releases it, and then observes exactly one marked generic failure.
- Negative E2E coverage proves both message-tool and source-reply delivery suppress the duplicate.
- Reply-threading coverage proves filtered payloads cannot consume `replyToMode: first`, enabled display lanes share the slot, and message-tool dedupe sees the final routed target.
- Unit coverage includes exhausted, completed, and heartbeat terminal results plus preservation of existing visible terminal payloads.
- Fresh post-rebase full-branch autoreview: no accepted/actionable findings (confidence 0.91).
- Source-blind behavior validation on Testbox `tbx_01kwsnw1132ts7a0v3sg6sg3tm` passed all 5 clauses:
  - 295/295 focused unit/E2E tests passed.
  - Real local/Gateway TUI PTY lane passed 7/7, including validation failures, fresh sessions, followup queueing, cancellation, and recovery.
  - Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28749300454

No config, protocol, dependency, or storage surface changes.

Co-authored with and preserves credit for @moeedahmed's original report and patch direction.
